verses.en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.pt: O Senhor é o meu pastor; nada me faltará.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> The Lord takes care of me as his sheep; I will not be without any good thing.

verses.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.pt: Deitar-me faz em pastos verdejantes; guia-me mansamente a águas tranqüilas.
verses.en_web: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.en_bbe: He makes a resting-place for me in the green fields: he is my guide by the quiet waters.

verses.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.pt: Refrigera a minha alma; guia-me nas veredas da justiça por amor do seu nome.
verses.en_web: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: He gives new life to my soul: he is my guide in the ways of righteousness because of his name.

verses.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.pt: Ainda que eu ande pelo vale da sombra da morte, não temerei mal algum, porque tu estás comigo; a tua vara e o teu cajado me consolam.
verses.en_web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, though I go through the valley of deep shade, I will have no fear of evil; for you are with me, your rod and your support are my comfort.

verses.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.pt: Preparas uma mesa perante mim na presença dos meus inimigos; unges com óleo a minha cabeça, o meu cálice transborda.
verses.en_web: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.en_bbe: You make ready a table for me in front of my haters: you put oil on my head; my cup is overflowing.

verses.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.pt: Certamente que a bondade e a misericórdia me seguirão todos os dias da minha vida, e habitarei na casa do Senhor por longos dias.
verses.en_web: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, blessing and mercy will be with me all the days of my life; and I will have a place in the house of the Lord all my days.
